briefs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished landscape art-direction comparison board for ISEKAID, an adult female 3D anime adventure companion. This is CONCEPT ART, never a Unity screenshot or a claimed mesh render. Use the supplied images as reference inputs only: first two are actual Woman by Fly_jkey audit front/profile, third is an earlier candidate concept.
Study the audit base: a featureless narrow head, strongly projecting rounded chest, pinched waist and broad hips. Our goal is to ARTISTICALLY ADAPT THAT BASE: reduce chest projection to moderate volume, broaden the pinched waist, soften outer hips/thigh transition, preserve adult human stature and limbs. Do not reproduce its exaggerated hourglass as neutral.
Show two equally sized labeled alternatives on a warm off-white design sheet. A is recommended: 'A | ANIME EQUILIBRADO'; B: 'B | ANIME GRAFICO'. Both represent the SAME adult woman, about 25–30, same average balanced body, outfit, hair length and colors, same neutral relaxed front standing pose, feet flat, no hip tilt, no arch, no sensual presentation. Under each full body include a large front head portrait and a small head profile, allowing direct style comparison. A: visibly 3D anime cel-shaded volume, adult oval face, soft jaw, moderate large almond eyes, visible upper eyelid thickness, subtle dimensional nose and lips, deep hazel-green irises. B: equally adult but more graphic anime, slightly wider eye opening, simpler face planes, sharper shadow regions, not chibi and not childlike. Difference is face/shading language, not personality or body size.
Both have warm dark brown long loose hair to lower back, grouped readable locks, side part with eyebrows and eyes visible. Simple opaque light ivory short-sleeve top with shallow closed rounded neckline, no cleavage or crop, untucked hem overlaps waistband; charcoal brown straight/slightly tapered medieval fabric trousers, room at knees, no denim rivets or modern fashion zipper, plain low flat brown ankle boots. No corset, armor, weapons, class insignia, fancy belts, jewelry or props. Hair/eyes/clothes colors are only comparison swatches, never personality labels. Pose and skin lighting matched.
Clean graphic typography, generous layout, clear 3D modeled look not flat manga line drawing. Exact text only: top 'ISEK-001 | PROPUESTA ARTISTICA v0.1'; subtitle 'CONCEPTO ILUSTRADO - NO ES CAPTURA DE UNITY'; A and B labels as above; small footer 'MISMA APARIENCIA BASE. PERSONALIDAD INDEPENDIENTE.' High clarity full heads and full bodies, all feet visible.

Create landscape ISEKAID concept turnaround, SAME ADULT WOMAN as option A LEFT in supplied art board, 25-30, balanced average adult build, moderate chest and hips, natural waist, adult oval anime face, dimensional nose, expressive almond hazel-green eyes. 3D anime cel-shaded art reference, NOT Unity or actual mesh render. Four full-body equal-size views: front, exact side profile, rear, three-quarter. All views same scale, neutral posture feet flat no hip tilt, plain warm background, clean lighting. Dark brown long loose hair to lower back with grouped locks; keep face/eyebrows readable. Same ivory short-sleeved opaque top and charcoal-brown fabric trousers; improve initial board: top with closed SHALLOW ROUND neckline, NO V-neck, untucked overlaps waistband; trousers relaxed straight cut at thighs/knees, no tight jeans seams, no denim rivets; flat simple ankle boots. No belts corsets weapons jewelry or extra items. Rear view shows hair length; a small separate torso rear study beside it lifts hair visually aside to reveal top hem and waistband, labeled 'ESTUDIO DE PRENDA'. Include clear exact title 'ISEK-001 | A - NEUTRAL PROPUESTA'; subtitle 'CONCEPTO ILUSTRADO - NO ES CAPTURA DE UNITY'; view labels 'FRENTE', 'PERFIL', 'ESPALDA', 'TRES CUARTOS'. No metrics or claimed model topology.

Create precise visual ART-CONCEPT range comparison board for ISEKAID, based on ADULT female option A LEFT of supplied reference. This is an illustrated target, NOT measured mesh, NOT Unity screenshot. Landscape 3 rows x 3 columns on warm light background. Each cell shows same adult woman from collarbone through upper calves, consistent camera scale neutral posture and no arch, matte opaque GRAY simple fitted short-sleeved top and gray trousers, no cleavage, no skin emphasis, no hair occluding torso. Three rows vary ONE control only, other controls remain neutral. Row1 labeled 'PECHO | PERFIL': exact SIDE-profile torso/pelvis, column1 '0 - MENOR', column2 '0.5 - NEUTRAL', column3 '1 - MAYOR'; clearly lower/moderate/higher chest projection on same ribcage, waist and hips unchanged. Row2 labeled 'CADERAS | FRENTE': front views, narrower/moderate/broader hips transitioning smoothly to upper thighs, same chest waist shoulders legs and knee position. Row3 labeled 'CINTURA | FRENTE': narrower/natural/broader waist, avoid pinched corset and avoid exaggerated hourglass, chest hip and shoulder widths unchanged. Woman is clearly adult average build even at minimum. Show perceptible but moderate differences, maximum never resembles exaggerated audit original. Same pose clothes camera for every panel in each row, neutral balanced body. 3D anime clay cel-shaded forms. Exact title 'ISEK-001 | EXTREMOS VISUALES PROPUESTOS'; subtitle 'CONCEPTO ILUSTRADO - NO ES CAPTURA DE UNITY'; footer 'UN EJE A LA VEZ. RANGOS SIN APROBAR. NO SON MEDIDAS DE MALLA.' No invented measurements, no personality names.

Create ISEKAID adult anime 3D facial-expression art proposal sheet. Use SAME adult face/identity as option A LEFT in reference, 25-30, soft adult oval jaw, moderately large almond hazel-green eyes, dimensional small nose, long loose dark brown side-parted hair, eyebrows visible, ivory closed round neck top. 8 equally sized head-and-shoulder panels 2 rows x4, clean warm background, cel-shaded 3D volume. NORMAL row of 4: 'NEUTRAL' attentive relaxed closed mouth; 'ALEGRIA' gentle smile and cheeks; 'MOLESTIA' brows inward and compressed lips no villain face; 'PREOCUPACION' inner brows raised concerned eyes mouth. Second row: 'VERGUENZA' subtle blush and gaze averted, adult and not coy sexual; 'PARPADEO' closed normal eyelids; 'SORPRESA COMICA' large white oval anime replacement eyes tiny dark pupils and simplified open mouth, same head silhouette; 'IRRITACION COMICA' sharp graphic simplified eyelid eyes and a small detached red anger symbol near temple. Comic panels deliberately replace normal eyes so no duplicate sets of eyes. Same person in all, no anatomy or clothing or hair changes by personality. No tsundere/yandere labels. Exact title 'ISEK-001 | ROSTRO Y EXPRESIONES - PROPUESTA'; subtitle 'CONCEPTO ILUSTRADO - NO ES CAPTURA DE UNITY'; small footer 'MUESTRAS DE DISENO. RIG FACIAL Y SISTEMA HIBRIDO PENDIENTES.' This is concept art of a future face, not implemented blend shapes.
